subtasks: Place each tool into its matching position in the toolbox, then reset the robot arm.
Pick up the adjustable wrench lying left of the toolbox and lay it flat in its matching recess.
Lift the diagonal adjustable wrench clear of the hammer, align it lengthwise in the narrow recess immediately right of the hammer, and lower and release it flat.
Place the pliers and tape measure into their respective matching recesses on the right side of the toolbox using the right arm.
Straighten the diagonal adjustable wrench in its middle recess beside the hammer. Keep the other tools seated, then fully open both grippers and return both arms to their initial poses.
Withdraw the right gripper upward from the toolbox, fully open both grippers, and return both arms to their initial poses.
